en.title: White House confirms Trump-Xi-Putin trilateral summit in China, Iran and nuclear arms on agenda
en.dek: US President Donald Trump will meet Russian President Vladimir Putin and Chinese President Xi Jinping in Shenzhen on November 19, according to the White House.
facts: White House confirms upcoming trilateral summit in China on November 19 between US President Donald Trump, Russian President Vladimir Putin, and Chinese President Xi Jinping
US officials stated discussions will focus on nuclear arms reduction and the war against Iran
US officials said talks on Ukraine will continue separately from the summit
Democratic US senators Jeanne Shaheen and Chris Coons told Elon Musk to preserve records related to SpaceX restrictions on Ukraine's Starlink and Starshield services
Senators set a November 30 deadline for confirmation of the preservation of records
Ukrainian forces stated that the military-grade Starshield system is vital for frontline communications and drone operations
body: The White House confirmed that US President Donald Trump will meet Russian President Vladimir Putin and Chinese President Xi Jinping in Shenzhen on November 19 for a trilateral summit.
US officials stated that discussions will focus on nuclear arms reduction and the war against Iran, while noting that talks on Ukraine will continue separately from the summit.
Democratic US senators Jeanne Shaheen and Chris Coons told Elon Musk to preserve records related to SpaceX restrictions on Ukraine's Starlink and Starshield services.

Senators set a November 30 deadline for confirmation of the preservation of these records, citing the importance of the military-grade Starshield system for Ukrainian frontline communications and drone operations.
The Kyiv Post reported that Ukrainian forces consider the Starshield system vital for frontline communications and drone operations, according to reports.
The Hindu reported that Democratic U.S. senators ordered Musk to preserve records on Ukraine Starlink access, citing the strategic importance of the system.
en.context: The developments occur against a backdrop of ongoing US-Russia-China diplomatic engagement and increasing congressional scrutiny of SpaceX's satellite technology support for Ukraine.
